name: @renki/mac-node
description: Lends a Mac's adb (and the phone plugged into it) to a Renki daemon. See README.md.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/renki-mac-node.mjs && esbuild src/runner-wrapper.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/runner-image/renki-runner.mjs && cp runner-image/Dockerfile runner-image/renki-linux-arm64.gradle dist/runner-image/
